description: Yoga Dublin's class schedule: what is on, where, when, who is teaching and a book_url for each class. A class carries spaces_left only once it is nearly full, so no spaces_left means it has room; full and waitlist_open mark one that has gone. Covers yoga, hot yoga, Pilates, Reformer, barre and meditation at all four studios. Filter class_name=hot for hot yoga. Up to 14 days ahead.

available_only.description: true returns only classes with a space left

class_name.description: Part of the class name, case-insensitive

studio.description: Rathmines, Ranelagh, Harold's Cross or Charlemont, or part of one
